title: Overlord: Ple Ple Pleiades 2
justification: AniList 101083 (ONA, 13 episode(s) from 2018-01-09) is AniDB 12952's special(s) S1-S13, aired 2018-01-09 to 2018-04-03. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 12952. The parent's row anidbseason 0 -> tvdbseason 0, start 1 end 13 offset 15 puts S1-S13 on TVDB 0x16-0x28, which carry the same titles and dates.
